info.title: Carthagent local dashboard API
info.summary: Local HTTP API served by server.mjs (`npm start`) for the browser dashboard.
info.description: The dashboard binds to 127.0.0.1 only, on `CARTHAGENT_PORT` (default 3000; 0 picks an ephemeral port). It operates on the workspace in `CARTHAGENT_WORKSPACE` (default: the current directory) and persists delivery state as report files under that workspace. Every `/api/*` request must send the session token in the `x-carthagent-token` header; the token is `CARTHAGENT_SERVER_TOKEN` when set, otherwise a random value printed once in the startup URL (`/?token=...`). Requests that send an `Origin` header must come from the dashboard origin itself. Request bodies are JSON (`express.json`, 1 MB limit); malformed JSON or oversize bodies are rejected by Express before reaching a handler (400/413). All `/api/*` responses carry `cache-control: no-store`. Mutating endpoints (`/api/design`, `/api/plan/set`, `/api/plan/revise`, `/api/checks/run`, `/api/review`, `/api/finish`) first take a cross-process workspace lease and answer 409 when it is unavailable. Non-API GET requests serve the static dashboard from `public/` and fall back to `public/index.html`; they are not part of this API.

post.description: Implementation is locked until the current plan revision has been validated, inspected, reviewed and approved on the current source fingerprint. For `review`, the review fields may be sent inside `review` or at the top level; `review.id` is accepted as `captureId`.

post.summary: Run one or all plan checks and record evidence
post.description: Requires an approved design (implementation must be unlocked). Checks run serially in the workspace without a shell; each result records exit code, timing, output tail, a log path and whether the workspace changed while the check ran. A check passes only when it exits 0, did not time out, was not cancelled, stayed within the output limit and left the workspace fingerprint unchanged.

500.description: Implementation is still locked by the design gate, or running the checks failed.

post.description: `inspect` captures the Git diff (or a no-repository notice) for review. `record` stores the review against that capture; all checks must be fresh.

dashboardToken.name: x-carthagent-token
dashboardToken.description: Dashboard session token: `CARTHAGENT_SERVER_TOKEN`, or the random token printed in the startup URL. Compared in constant time.

id.description: Unique safe identifier (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,39}$`, not `all`). Harness-required checks use the `required_` prefix.

argv.description: Executable and separate arguments; no implicit shell.

dependsOn.description: Step IDs this step depends on (acyclic).

checks.description: Check IDs gating this step; must be empty for regression steps.

Plan.description: Delivery plan. `required` verification needs acceptance criteria and at least one test or runtime check; every acceptance item must reference existing check IDs.

artifacts.description: Relative artifact roots that exist at completion (for example `.` or `src`).

steps.description: 1 to 40 steps; strings are legacy sequential labels.

design.description: Tested design record used by the design gate.

PlanPatch.description: Nonempty subset of plan fields; `design` and `workflow` objects are shallow-merged.

DesignReview.description: Design review record; validated by lib/planning.mjs.

captureId.description: Required for record: ID of the latest inspect capture.

probes.description: Boundary or metamorphic probes with observed results.
